structural_change: QW-COLLIO 10-20 band: codec-band successor of qfd_coll_face_s1_safe (FAIL: codec0 TT pin spread 450.8 ps / CTS rc2; s1 r4: reach 554 um, spread 306, reg->macro -551). Root cause: no codec std-cell region - 4 W-pinned banks sat between the CDC channels and the PHY pins (950 um flow axis), so codec0 sinks scattered over every macro channel. Now W->E flow: W pins -> CDC column (ch546 TX R0 / RX MY, banks 0/1 MY with pins facing the band) -> dedicated full-height codec band 198.7 um -> banks 2/3 R0 (pins facing band) -> PHY pins on E (<=260 um over banks). No rotated macros. Same SAFE=1 RTL/bench as s1_safe. band2: cal_ck boundary group compacted (band gate FAIL cal_ck pin-flop spread 212.3 ps: cdc_fault out regs sat 200 um below the tx_data/tx_slot pin-reg group); cdc_fault moved beside tx_slot. band4: PHY pin-register group compacted around codec0 (E 328..573, ~5.7 pins/um; qfd_coll_face_s1_band2 codec0 boundary spread 150.3/231.8 ps over a 370 um E span).
